resources.string: Automatic detection supports multilingual speech. A hint describes the language you speak, not the language to translate into. Use it only when short phrases or dialects are misidentified.
This model detects languages automatically and has no manual language input.
Multilingual Whisper only. Uses its native translation task; the language hint still refers to the spoken language.

Offline conversion using OpenCC dictionaries before text is inserted. Taiwan mode also converts regional vocabulary; Hong Kong mode adjusts glyph variants. Follow system uses Taiwan for TW, Hong Kong for HK/MO, Traditional for Hant, and Simplified otherwise. English translation and recognized Japanese bypass conversion. Ambiguous words and names may need correction.
